name: Coordinated Inauthentic Behavior
description: Detection and analysis of coordinated link sharing, inauthentic networks, and manipulated amplification on social media platforms, including the CooRnet/CLSB methodology the researcher co-developed and its downstream successors. A core, long-running methodological and empirical program spanning elections, health topics, and information operations worldwide.

name: Information Disorder & Disinformation
description: Study of misinformation, disinformation narratives, and problematic content circulation across news and social media, including EU-funded monitoring of disinformation trajectories (PROMPT) and countering disinformation with AI-based verification tools (vera.ai).

name: Generative AI, Persuasion & Synthetic Media
description: Emerging research on generative AI's role in producing and countering persuasive content, deceptive information operations, and synthetic visual/textual media, including AI's capacity to sway beliefs, reduce conspiracy thinking, and power coordinated gambling promotion or 'zombie internet' campaigns.

name: Platform Governance & Content Moderation
description: Analysis of platform policy, the Digital Services Act era, data access APIs for researchers, and algorithmic governance shaping content visibility (e.g., Meta's political content reduction policy, Community Notes, and research API ecosystems post-CrowdTangle).

name: Political Polarization & Partisanship
description: Investigation of affective and media-driven polarization, partisan attention and engagement patterns, and the interplay between social and traditional media in amplifying political divides, a recurring theoretical and empirical concern across the researcher's publications.

name: Italian Elections & News Ecosystem (MINE)
description: The MINE research program's core empirical focus: mapping Italian news media coverage, Facebook/Instagram interaction patterns, and political communication dynamics across Italian general and European elections since 2017, the institutional umbrella for the researcher's ongoing work.

name: Computational Methods & LLMs for Social Media Research
description: Development and validation of computational and NLP methods for communication research, including LLM-in-the-loop pipelines for political discourse classification, embedding model comparisons, and workflows for detecting coordinated accounts.

name: Health Misinformation Networks
description: Studies mapping coordinated networks that spread problematic health information, including COVID-19 fact-checking acceleration and cross-national analyses of health misinformation circulation in India and Nigeria.

name: Cross-National Coordinated Campaigns & Elections
description: Comparative analysis of coordinated behavior and political advertising across national election contexts (Germany 2021, Brazil, Latin America), examining how information campaigns and inauthentic networks operate beyond Italy.

name: Digital Authoritarianism & State Propaganda
description: Tracking of state-sponsored manipulation, troll networks, and generative-AI-enabled propaganda in democratically weakened or authoritarian contexts, an emerging thread connecting the researcher's coordinated-behavior expertise to geopolitical information warfare.

name: Platforms, Audiences, and Online Communities
description: Empirical and reflective studies of how platform affordances, cultures, and audience practices shape online sociality, identity, and community formation across sites like Facebook, TikTok, Instagram, Twitter/Mastodon, and LiveJournal.

name: Critical Analysis of AI Industry Imaginaries and Discourse
description: Studies examining how AI industry actors, media, and communities construct and circulate narratives, imaginaries, and framings (e.g., longtermism, techno-hagiography, 'quiet futuring', political-economy 'decoys') that shape public understanding and obscure or legitimize the underlying power structures of AI development.
